source_text: Ella!

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Ella!

source_text: 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp.1Hero!

source_text: The monsters escaped!

structure.raw_value: BoWoEx^.The monsters escaped!

source_text: We saw monsters!

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.We saw monsters!

source_text: Nellie left before the demons came out of the rift. She hasn’t returned!

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx.Nellie left before the demons came out of the rift. She hasn’t returned!
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx.Nellie left before the demons came out of the rift. She hasn’t returned!"

translation: Nellie wyszła, zanim demony wydostały się z rozdarcia. Jeszcze nie wróciła!

source_text: A smoke break? I don’t know.

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe^.A smoke break? I don’t know.

source_text: Erica’s body is gone!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Erica’s body is gone!

source_text: I failed to save her.

structure.raw_value: ArSaCl^.I failed to save her.

translation: Nie udało mi się jej uratować.

source_text: Did you dye your hair?

structure.raw_value: BoWoCl^.Did you dye your hair?

source_text: Are those wings?

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.Are those wings?

source_text: A demon named Daemalius took Erica and he’s looking to take revenge on Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.A demon named Daemalius took Erica and he’s looking to take revenge on Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.A demon named Daemalius took Erica and he’s looking to take revenge on Madalyn."

translation: Demon imieniem Daemalius porwał Ericę i chce zemścić się na Madalyn.

source_text: Another demon?

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.Another demon?

source_text: Madalyn tricked him and used him to open the rift.

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.Madalyn tricked him and used him to open the rift.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoEx.Madalyn tricked him and used him to open the rift."

translation: Madalyn go oszukała i wykorzystała, żeby otworzyć rozdarcie.

source_text: Did you see Lilith? Did the demons have the Toma with them?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Did you see Lilith? Did the demons have the Toma with them?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Did you see Lilith? Did the demons have the Toma with them?"

translation: Widziałeś Lilith? Demony miały ze sobą Tomę?

source_text: Negative. Only demons and no statue to be seen.

structure.raw_value: BoBaEx^.Negative. Only demons and no statue to be seen.
structure.script_literal: "BoBaEx^.Negative. Only demons and no statue to be seen."

translation: Nie. Były tam tylko demony, żadnego posągu.

source_text: I have no idea where Lillian is.

structure.raw_value: ElWoCl.I have no idea where Lillian is.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoCl.I have no idea where Lillian is."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, gdzie jest Lillian.

source_text: Guess who has a bomb?

structure.raw_value: TaHaEx>.Guess who has a bomb?

source_text: You have a bomb?

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.You have a bomb?

source_text: Are you here to arrest me?

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Are you here to arrest me?

source_text: Not exactly the highest priority right now.

structure.raw_value: ObWoCl.Not exactly the highest priority right now.
structure.script_literal: "ObWoCl.Not exactly the highest priority right now."

translation: To nie jest teraz nasz najpilniejszy problem.

source_text: Tasha, Daemalius is back!

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.Tasha, Daemalius is back!

source_text: We lost her… This new demon named Daemalius took her.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.We lost her… This new demon named Daemalius took her.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.We lost her… This new demon named Daemalius took her."

translation: Straciliśmy ją… Porwał ją nowy demon, Daemalius.

source_text: We have to open the rift and bomb the shit out of it.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx^.We have to open the rift and bomb the shit out of it.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx^.We have to open the rift and bomb the shit out of it."

translation: Musimy otworzyć rozdarcie i rozwalić je w drobny mak.

source_text: That’s not the plan.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.That’s not the plan.

source_text: We lost Erica and we have a bomb. It’s worth a shot.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx^.We lost Erica and we have a bomb. It’s worth a shot.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx^.We lost Erica and we have a bomb. It’s worth a shot."

translation: Straciliśmy Ericę, a mamy bombę. Warto spróbować.

source_text: It could work… All of the worlds are vulnerable to attack.

structure.raw_value: ArWoDe^.It could work… All of the worlds are vulnerable to attack.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoDe^.It could work… All of the worlds are vulnerable to attack."

translation: To może zadziałać… Wszystkie światy są narażone na atak.

source_text: Daemalius wants revenge. He’ll come here. I know it.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Daemalius wants revenge. He’ll come here. I know it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Daemalius wants revenge. He’ll come here. I know it."

translation: Daemalius chce zemsty. Przyjdzie tutaj. Wiem to.

source_text: 1Hero… What do we do?

structure.raw_value: ElSaOp.1Hero… What do we do?

source_text: I…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I…

source_text: Find hairs from Lillian or any other demon part…

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx^.Find hairs from Lillian or any other demon part…
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx^.Find hairs from Lillian or any other demon part…"

translation: Znajdź włosy Lillian albo inną część demona…

source_text: You know what to do, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe^.You know what to do, 1Hero.

source_text: If this new monster comes here, what the hell are we supposed to do?

structure.raw_value: BoAnDe^.If this new monster comes here, what the hell are we supposed to do?
structure.script_literal: "BoAnDe^.If this new monster comes here, what the hell are we supposed to do?"

translation: Jeśli ten nowy potwór tu przyjdzie, co mamy, do cholery, zrobić?

source_text: We have an arsenal of holy weapons.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx^.We have an arsenal of holy weapons.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx^.We have an arsenal of holy weapons."

source_text: I can help. I can help protect everyone.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx^.I can help. I can help protect everyone.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx^.I can help. I can help protect everyone."

source_text: I’ve got the amulets.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx>.I’ve got the amulets.

source_text: And we have holy bombs.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx^.And we have holy bombs.

source_text: This is insane.

structure.raw_value: OaWoCl.This is insane.

source_text: Father can handle demons. I’ve seen it.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Father can handle demons. I’ve seen it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Father can handle demons. I’ve seen it."

translation: Ojciec potrafi radzić sobie z demonami. Widziałem to.

source_text: Why are you here? Who’s keeping an eye on the girls?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Why are you here? Who’s keeping an eye on the girls?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Why are you here? Who’s keeping an eye on the girls?"

translation: Czemu tu jesteś? Kto pilnuje dziewczyn?

source_text: They are safe in the church. Stay focused.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx^.They are safe in the church. Stay focused.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx^.They are safe in the church. Stay focused."

translation: Są bezpieczne w kościele. Skup się.

source_text: Hey… Where’s Mom?

structure.raw_value: TaWoOp>.Hey… Where’s Mom?

source_text: I’ll search the mansion for Nellie… and see if I can find more demon parts to open the rift.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ll search the mansion for Nellie… and see if I can find more demon parts to open the rift.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ll search the mansion for Nellie… and see if I can find more demon parts to open the rift."

translation: Przeszukam rezydencję w poszukiwaniu Nellie… i sprawdzę, czy znajdę więcej części demona, by otworzyć rozdarcie.

source_text: Erica’s soul could be waiting for us on the other side.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx.Erica’s soul could be waiting for us on the other side.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx.Erica’s soul could be waiting for us on the other side."

translation: Dusza Eriki może czekać na nas po drugiej stronie.

source_text: If only we had the body…

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.If only we had the body…

source_text: Father… Stay here and make sure everyone is safe.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Father… Stay here and make sure everyone is safe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Father… Stay here and make sure everyone is safe."

translation: Ojcze… Zostań tutaj i dopilnuj, żeby wszyscy byli bezpieczni.

source_text: Hurry and open the rift. We have to save Erica… And find the Toma.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx.Hurry and open the rift. We have to save Erica… And find the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx.Hurry and open the rift. We have to save Erica… And find the Toma."

translation: Pospiesz się i otwórz rozdarcie. Musimy uratować Ericę… i odnaleźć Tomę.

source_text: Lillian!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Lillian!

source_text: Has Erica arrived?

structure.raw_value: LiWoOp.Has Erica arrived?

source_text: She’s in Hell…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.She’s in Hell…

source_text: Shit… What a mess.

structure.raw_value: LiAnOp.Shit… What a mess.

source_text: You can’t hide, sister!

structure.raw_value: ErMaAg.You can’t hide, sister!

source_text: Having trouble keeping up, brother?

structure.raw_value: MlFlDe.Having trouble keeping up, brother?

source_text: You’ve chosen the wrong place to run. Do you dare bring me to Hell?

structure.raw_value: ErMaAgNo1^.You’ve chosen the wrong place to run. Do you dare bring me to Hell?
structure.script_literal: "ErMaAgNo1^.You’ve chosen the wrong place to run. Do you dare bring me to Hell?"

translation: Źle wybrałeś miejsce ucieczki. Naprawdę chcesz zabrać mnie do piekła?

source_text: What better place to end this feud?

structure.raw_value: MlFlDe.What better place to end this feud?
structure.script_literal: "MlFlDe.What better place to end this feud?"

translation: Czy jest lepsze miejsce, by zakończyć ten spór?

source_text: Uhh… That could be a problem… The girls are in Hell too.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Uhh… That could be a problem… The girls are in Hell too.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Uhh… That could be a problem… The girls are in Hell too."

translation: Eee… To może być problem… Dziewczyny też są w piekle.

source_text: You can’t run anymore. It’s time to make this right.

structure.raw_value: ErMaAg^.You can’t run anymore. It’s time to make this right.
structure.script_literal: "ErMaAg^.You can’t run anymore. It’s time to make this right."

translation: Nie możesz już uciekać. Czas to naprawić.

source_text: Shit!... Run!

structure.raw_value: MlWoCl.Shit!... Run!
